description: This file defines the OAuth2Tokens class, which extends SugarBean and manages OAuth2 token data within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes properties for tokens, scopes, expiry times, and methods for generating summaries, obtaining current timestamps, and creating list queries with user-specific access controls.

classes.name: OAuth2Tokens
classes.description: Represents OAuth2 token data within SuiteCRM, providing methods for token management, querying, and access control.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a short summary string of the token, based on the ID.

methods.name: getNowDateString
methods.description: Returns the current date and time as a string, utilizing the database's 'now' function.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query for listing OAuth2 tokens, with user-based access restrictions and optional export formatting.
